THE MAISON PHILOSOPHY

Trends come and go.
You remain.

We believe the most beautiful thing you can wear is a sense of yourself. An easy confidence. A silhouette that feels just right. A detail only you notice.

Maison Aurèle is an imagined wardrobe for a life well dressed — a place to explore expressive tailoring, effortless eveningwear, and the small things that bring it all together.

How to use and change this website — easy steps
  1. Save the file with the name index.html.
  2. Double-click it. Your website opens in your web browser, even without the internet!
  3. Try the four links at the top: Home, Collections, Our story and Contact.
  4. In Collections, choose a category to filter the pictures. Click a picture to make it bigger. Press Escape or × to close it.
  5. Write a friendly message and press “Show my message”. It stays on this page until you refresh or close it.
  6. Want to change the words? Make a spare copy first. Then open index.html in a text editor, find the words, change them and save. Refresh your browser to see your changes.
  7. Keep the symbols in angle brackets, like <h1>, in place. They help the browser build the page!
